title: Iran war costs surpass $48.3 billion; Pentagon yet to assess base damage
description:
The costs of the Iran war have risen to an estimated USD 48.3 billion as of November 13, but because that total does not include damage to US bases attacked in West Asia, lawmakers are pushing for the Pentagon to provide those figures.
Arthur Miller, a Pentagon budget official, provided the latest overall cost estimate on Thursday to the Senate Armed Services Committee, which is considering his nomination to be Navy comptroller. The USD 48 billion figure includes the costs of military operations, as well as for replacing equipment and munitions.
Democratic Sen Richard Blumenthal of Connecticut pressed Miller for an estimate on damage to US installations, which Miller said he didn't have. Republican Sen Roger Wicker of Mississippi, the committee's chair, directed Miller to try to provide an answer as soon as possible.
